---
title: "Video Game Duration"
---

An analysis of video game completion times from HowLongToBeat.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)

# Load data
games <- read_csv("howlongtobeat.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Select top popular games and reshape for comparison
top_games <- games |>
  filter(!is.na(main_story_hours), !is.na(completionist_hours)) |>
  slice_head(n = 12) |>
  select(game_name, `Main Story` = main_story_hours, `Completionist` = completionist_hours) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Main Story`, `Completionist`), names_to = "Playstyle", values_to = "Hours")

p <- top_games |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(game_name, Hours), y = Hours, fill = Playstyle)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Main Story" = "#375a7f", "Completionist" = "#e74c3c")) +
  labs(
    title = "Main Story vs. 100% Completionist (Top Games)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Hours to Beat"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),
    text = element_text(color = "#ffffff"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#ffffff"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA)
  )

ggplotly(p) |>
  layout(
    paper_bgcolor = "#222222",
    plot_bgcolor = "#222222",
    font = list(color = "#ffffff"),
    legend = list(font = list(color = "#ffffff"))
  )
```
